sloka: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य कुम्भकर्णः प्लवङ्गमम्।तस्थौ विकृतसर्वाङ्गो वानरेन्द्रसमुन्मुखः ।। ६.६७.५४ ।।
transliteration: tamāpatantaṁ samprekṣya kumbhakarṇaḥ plavaṅgamam।tasthau vikṛtasarvāṅgo vānarendrasamunmukhaḥ ।। 6.67.54 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva, of great prowess lifting a mountain peak, whirled it round and round and darted towards Kumbhakarna swiftly.
